title: Cash Pickup Error Notices and Resolution Under the Remittance Transfer Rule
content:
**Error-resolution team notice: Cash Pickup errors under the Remittance Transfer Rule.**

## Kinds of error

Under the Remittance Transfer Rule the customer may give notice of one of three kinds of error on a Cash Pickup transfer:

- **not available by the date**: the cash was not available by the disclosed date of availability;
- **paid to the wrong person**: the cash was recorded as paid to someone other than the recipient;
- **incorrect amount**: the recipient was handed less than the disclosed cash amount.

The notice is the customer's own assertion, and the customer gives it.

## Notice window

A notice can be given only within the tier's error-notice window, counted in calendar days after the disclosed date of availability. The count starts from the disclosed date. A notice on the disclosed date plus the window days is on time.

Hypothetical case: disclosed date 10 January in a non-leap year, 180-day window. 9 July is the last on-time day, and a notice on 10 July is late.

Only one notice of each kind may be open on a transfer at a time.

## Decision

The decision is due by the notice date plus the tier's investigation days, in calendar days. Hypothetical case: a notice dated 5 March with a 90-day period is due for decision by 3 June.

The team decides "no error" when the cause lies with the customer, for example when the customer shared the Pickup Number with the person who collected. Otherwise it decides "error found".

On "error found", every fee collected is refunded and recorded as a Paloma error, unless it was already refunded under the on-time promise.

## Remedies

A remedy can be chosen only after a decision of "error found" on that notice.

| Kind of error | Remedy |
|---|---|
| paid to the wrong person | The customer chooses a refund of the principal, or a re-issue under a new Pickup Number at no cost. Either is funded by Paloma as an error-refund or error-re-issue credit. The choice is the customer's own. |
| incorrect amount | Paloma's shortfall credit is booked. The customer chooses to have the shortfall collected under a re-issue for the shortfall alone, or refunded. A shortfall refund is booked on the error-shortfall basis. |
| not available by the date | the fee refund |

A refund is issued within the tier's refund business days, and a re-issue is made available within the tier's re-issue business days, both counted from the choice.

**Retired clause.** The clause stating that, for an incorrect amount, Paloma credits the shortfall is **no longer in force** as the measure of Paloma's credit. The amount of the shortfall credit is fixed on its current basis.

superseded_clauses: For incorrect_amount Paloma credits the shortfall (credit_reason incorrect_amount_shortfall)
